result:
Lane pmc188 is finished and fold-ready. Attempt 3 changed no code and merged nothing, because the conflict it was sent to resolve did not exist.

**The handback's premise was false.** It said PR #198 "no longer merges into `master`" and made resolving that the whole task. Four checks say otherwise:

| check | result |
|---|---|
| `git merge-base --is-ancestor origin/master HEAD` | yes — `bda6c52d9c` is an ancestor of the head |
| `git rev-list --left-right --count origin/master...HEAD` | `0 9` — nothing to merge in |
| `gh pr view 198 --json mergeable` | `MERGEABLE` / `CLEAN` |
| check rollup on `d6edc21944` | build, build, check — all SUCCESS at 14:52Z |

Master being an *ancestor* of the head makes the fold a fast-forward, which cannot conflict.

**The real blocker was a label.** Attempt 2 did the merge its handback asked for and pushed it, then stopped without running the two label commands at the bottom of that same handback. `needs-rebase` stayed on, `fold-ready` was never applied, and `fold.sh` gates on `fold-ready` — so the PR sat. The 15:22 `[job.handback]` resumed on that stale label, not on a fresh merge attempt, which is why no `[job.fold]` comment after 14:20 ever asserts a conflict.

Merging "just in case" would have cost an empty merge commit, a new head, another CI cycle and another tick of delay — and left the actual defect untouched.

What I did: re-ran the gates on this head rather than inheriting a verdict from two heads ago (`preflight.sh` passed including nv2a index/territory/coverage/board files; `pmc_enable_selftest.sh` 8 checks, 0 failures; `pmc.c` still one `pmc_read` hunk; `pmc_write` sha `20150c04ab69…` identical to master's). Appended the attempt-3 section to `docs/lanes/pmc188/NOTES.md` and corrected the status line at the top so the summary doesn't still read as attempt 2. Pushed `74793b3b70`, waited for CI (all three green), removed `needs-rebase`, applied `fold-ready`, and posted the `[lane.pmc188]` comment.

Final state: `74793b3b70`, OPEN, not draft, MERGEABLE/CLEAN, labels `[fold-ready]`, `Files:` matches `git diff --stat`, `Prediction: none: no arm`. The #188 scope invariants are unchanged — the read returns `0x01110000`, `pmc_write` is byte-for-byte untouched, and the bit-field semantics remain unmodelled and unconfirmed.
